result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears largely functional and well-designed. A few minor visual issues were found related to content truncation and inconsistent styling.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge with truncated text and image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal carousel items show a clearer partial peek or adjust spacing so the truncation looks intentional rather than broken.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons are inconsistent - one card has a white circle background with dark heart, another has a dark circle with white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon styling across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is cut off, showing only a partial image and no restaurant details.
issues.suggestion: This is expected scroll behavior, but ensure the fade or cutoff aligns cleanly with the navigation bar boundary.
